name: Alaska Air Group
outlook:
What Alaska Air Group says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: capacity and unit metricsAir Group expects capacity to grow approximately 1% to 1.5% year-over-year, with the increase concentrated in international flying. Unit revenue is expected to increase in the low double digits year-over-year and improve sequentially on a gross basis, supported by continued yield strength. Non-fuel unit costs are expected to increase in the mid-single digits, reflecting lower capacity growth.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted loss per shareFor the full year, we now expect an adjusted loss per share between ($5.50) and ($5.00), inclusive of $1.8 billion in fuel expense above our plan.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 20, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
